name: Conquering Arathi Basin
summary: A Horde Warbringer asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor. They are the required tokens for this request.

faq.q: What does the Horde Warbringer ask for?
faq.answer: The Horde Warbringer asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Where do I bring the marks?
faq.answer: Bring the marks to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

faq.q: How many Marks of Honor are needed?
faq.answer: You need three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

attribution: In-game quest text: Conquering Arathi Basin
